summary: The Course system manages courses, including adding, updating, and retrieving course details.
purpose: To facilitate the management of course data within the system.

entities.name: Course
entities.description: An entity representing a course with various attributes like name, duration, and type.

actors.name: Instructor
actors.description: An actor who may interact with course data for instructional purposes.

workflows.name: Manage Courses
steps: Create a new course or update an existing one.
Specify course details such as duration and type.

business_rules: Courses require a valid name and short name.
Duration cannot be zero if shifts are used.
validations: Name and ShortName must not be blank.
conditions: Course details displayed may depend on session parameters.
system_behavior: Automatic updating of course list based on user input.

dependencies.name: HSPnetSession
dependencies.description: Session object for maintaining user-specific context.

exceptions: Course cannot be added if name is not specified.
